assigned_value: Amended Title 35-A definition of transmission and distribution utility. A private-distribution exception for a northern Maine commercial or industrial site does not apply if more than 25% of the entity's nameplate capacity serves data centers on that site.
live_value: Amended Title 35-A definition of transmission and distribution utility. A private-distribution exception for a northern Maine commercial or industrial site does not apply if more than 25% of the entity's nameplate capacity serves data centers on that site.
after: Public Law 2025, chapter 85 adds an exception to the transmission and distribution utility definition for a qualifying commercial or industrial site in the ISO-New England control area, in a municipality north of Chester, historically served without a public utility transmission and distribution plant before December 31, 2018. That exception does not apply if more than 25% of the entity’s nameplate capacity serves data centers on that site.
